notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch succeeded fully - plain Python requests (no impersonation needed) returned HTTP 200 on the homepage and every category page tested; curl_cffi with chrome impersonation also returned 200 on homepage. robots.txt itself returned HTTP 421 'Misdirected Request' from Cloudflare on every attempt (plain requests, curl_cffi, http and https) while all real content pages returned 200 with full data - this is not a bot-block signal (no 403/CAPTCHA/Access Denied/DataDome), so tier (a) was used for the whole pass without escalating to Playwright or Claude-in-Chrome. TREE: site is Next.js SSR; pulled the full category tree from the __NEXT_DATA__ megaNav.meganavItems JSON blob on the homepage (12 top-level tabs: New, Furniture, Outdoor, Rugs, Lighting, Art & Mirrors, Vintage, Tabletop & Bar, Decor, Bed & Bath, Best-Sellers, Sale), then cross-checked against /htmlsitemap for any category not present in the mega nav (none found). QTY: pulled props.pageProps.total from each leaf category page's own __NEXT_DATA__ JSON (site's own exact product-listing count, same field BigCommerce/custom PLP uses for pagination), and confirmed h1/page_title/breadcrumb matched the requested node on every leaf recorded. Canonical URLs (from <link rel=canonical>) used for all links, which strip the ?nType=1 tracking param and the descriptive slug prefix. EXCLUDED and why: Rug Pads (padding/underlayment, not itself a textile or storage product) - neither. Rugs by Material / Rugs by Style / Runners / Vintage facet pages under Rugs - these are attribute-facet cross-sections of the same Area Rugs product pool already counted in the 5282 total (not distinct product-type subcategories), skipped to avoid double-counting the same catalog under different facets; Area Rugs, Outdoor Rugs and Doormats (the genuine 'Rugs by Category' product-type split) were kept. Bath Accessories (233 items - sampled: tissue box covers, soap dishes, waste baskets, decorative trays/tumblers - decorative bath accessories, not textile or storage per rules). Decorative Pillows/Throws under the Decor tab (category IDs 119518/119529) are the exact same category nodes already linked from Bed & Bath > Pillows & Throws - recorded once, not duplicated. Trays & Boxes (637 items - decorative trays/boxes/catchalls, purely decorative home accessories, not storage). Shelving & Brackets / 'Shelving, Brackets & Hardware' (117 items - sampled products are all decorative wall shelves/etageres and wall-mount brackets, i.e. Wall Decor boundary per storage.md SS18, not storage furniture). Storage Furniture (under Furniture > Office) and Entry Storage Furniture & Benches / Sideboards & Media Storage (under Furniture > Living Room / Entry) - explicitly placed inside the Furniture mega-nav column, so per storage.md SS15/SS21 preference these belong to Furniture.xlsx (already validated/complete), not Storage. Bags & Accessories (vintage fashion bags, apparel boundary). Outdoor Furniture, Outdoor Accents (planters/statuary/fire pits/garden stools), Outdoor Lighting, all Furniture-tab subcategories (sofas, tables, cabinets, beds, dressers, desks, bookcases, etc.), Tabletop subcategories other than Table & Kitchen Linens (Drinkware, Serveware, Dinnerware, Flatware, Bar Tools, Bar Carts), Art & Mirrors, Lighting tab, and all Decor tab subcategories other than Baskets & Organization (Vases & Jars, Decorative Accents, Planters, Floral & Greenery, Picture Frames, Candles & Diffusers, Books & Bookends, Desk & Stationery, Games & Recreation) - none are textile or storage per the two rule files' boundary sections. One ambiguous/mixed row was kept at LOW confidence rather than dropped: Outdoor > Storage & Covers (22 items) - sampled products are a genuine mix of storage items (Outdoor Storage Box, Outdoor Cushion Storage Box x3) and furniture (Outdoor Chaise Lounge, 2x Outdoor Sideboard) under one un-splittable listing URL/qty; flagged for manual review rather than silently including or excluding.
